param.label: Minimum base quality
param.help: Minimum base quality score for a base to be counted. Lower this for error-prone long reads (e.g. Nanopore); the SNV error model then assumes the matching error rate unless an error rate is set

param.label: Error rate
param.help: Per-base substitution error rate assumed when calling SNVs (e.g. 0.01 for 1 percent). If not set, it is calculated from the minimum base quality (0.001 for Q30, which uses the simulated model shipped with inStrain)

param.label: Use legacy SNV thresholds
param.help: Use the SNV calling thresholds of inStrain versions before 1.12, which required one fewer read than the FDR implies. Only useful for reproducing results from older versions

What it does ============
inStrain is python program for analysis of co-occurring genome populations from metagenomes that allows highly accurate genome comparisons, analysis of coverage, microdiversity, and linkage, and sensitive SNP detection with gene localization and synonymous non-synonymous identification.
Read more about the tool: https://instrain.readthedocs.io/en/latest/
